title: Batik paper-cut diorama look
problem: The owner chose the batik paper-cut diorama look (DEC-018): "use the batik paper card diorama". The game still shows the Hikayat look.
scope: Palette: batik paper colours (paper cream, kraft, indigo, soga brown, leaf greens) replace timber and parchment; team blue and red stay

Map, painted once as a paper diorama: batik-printed jungle cloth, cut-paper leaf canopies, kraft-paper lanes with torn edges, layered paper river with batik wave lines, paper bridges, camps, dens, cairns and shrines, all with soft paper shadows
Characters: every hero and troop becomes a die-cut paper standee (white cut edge, paper shadow, indigo-black ink) on a paper base in team colour; cached as now
Forts and the Pusaka as folded paper with batik-printed roofs (cached)
Fog of war as indigo dye with a faint batik crackle
Menus: indigo batik cloth behind paper cards (game screen, help, shop, settings, results, draft and versus screens)
Docs: art-style.md rewritten for the new look; phone-check screenshots; records
exclusions: New ultimate effect shapes (effects keep their shapes; colours follow the palette)
Keeping Hikayat as a switchable look (it stays in git history and preview version 7)

acceptance.text: The map, forts, fog and menus show the batik paper look in the game and on the draft and versus screens (browser screenshots reviewed)
acceptance.evidence: Phone-check screenshots reviewed (draft, versus, game start, command menu, shop, ultimate, result, zoomed): paper map, folded-paper forts, indigo batik fog, paper cards on indigo batik cloth; PHONE CHECK OK.

acceptance.text: Every hero and troop is a die-cut paper standee; teams still tell apart at play size (sprite sheet and game screenshots reviewed)
acceptance.evidence: Sprite sheets of all 20 heroes and 18 troop types: white cut edge and paper shadow on every pose (walk, attack, hurt, spawn); blue and red bases and sashes still read at 34 px and 21 px; game screenshots checked.

acceptance.text: Speed: drawing 100 cached figures stays under 1 ms on average; the map is painted once (measured)
acceptance.evidence: 100 cached figures: 0.84 ms average per frame (frames 40-119). Map painted once in 10-18 ms (before 8-15 ms); full frame median 3 ms (before 2.5 ms). Desktop Chromium with iPhone 13 emulation, not a real phone.

acceptance.text: Game unchanged: verify, determinism, soak and phone check pass; no change in src/game
acceptance.evidence: npm run verify: 93/93 tests, build, docs and records checks; npm run soak: 3/3 (120 matches and the no-stall run); PHONE CHECK OK; no change in src/game.
Not yet tried on the owner's phone.

acceptance.text: Owner's verdict on the new look

risks: Batik texture can turn into noise on a small screen: texture stays low-contrast and off the figures
Extra shadows could slow phones: shadows and cut edges are drawn once into caches, not every frame
Code-drawn paper is simpler than an artist's version

added: Batik patterns, die-cut paper helper and cached paper forts (src/ui/art.ts)
changed: Map painted as a paper diorama
Every character is a die-cut paper standee
Fog of war, HUD, menus, draft and versus screens in indigo batik and paper
removed: The Hikayat look (kept in git history and preview version 7)

userNotes: New look: a batik paper-cut diorama. Paper standees with white cut edges, a batik-printed jungle board, kraft-paper lanes, folded-paper forts, indigo batik fog and menus.

approval.evidence: use the batik paper card diorama
